message: "users" is renamed to "accounts". Running instances of the old code still use the old name and fail until they are replaced.
why: During a rolling deploy, the old and new versions of the application run at the same time. Renaming a table breaks the old version immediately.
safeAlternative: Create the new table (or a view with the old name for compatibility), copy the data, switch the code, and drop the old table in a later release.
